Varun Bansal
Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist | Hyderabad
varun.bansal807@example.com | +91 9647524586

Experienced talent acquisition professional with a background spanning hiring for tech and operations across startups and logistics firms. Combines data-driven sourcing and process optimization with hands-on technical understanding from earlier backend engineering experience to improve time-to-hire and quality of hire. Notice period: 15 days.

Experience
UrbanPantry — Aug 2024 - Present
Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
- Led end-to-end Recruitment for operations and tech roles, reducing average time-to-fill from 42 to 26 days by refining sourcing channels and interview coordination; filled 28 mid-senior roles in first 6 months using targeted pipelines. (Talent Acquisition, Recruitment)
- Built and maintained candidate tracking workflows in Confluence and Linux-hosted ATS integrations, improving data accessibility for hiring managers and cutting follow-up churn by 35%. (Confluence, Linux)
- Implemented structured interview scorecards and calibrated hiring panels, increasing offer acceptance rate from 62% to 78% for critical hires. (Recruitment, Talent Acquisition)

Medisure — Sep 2021 - Jul 2024
Talent Acquisition Specialist
- Managed full-cycle Recruitment for clinical, sales, and engineering teams, sourcing 180+ candidates and successfully hiring 95 across India with an average offer-to-acceptance conversion of 70%. (Recruitment, Talent Acquisition)
- Designed a referral and campus hiring program that contributed 40% of hires in FY22, reducing external sourcing costs by 22%. (Talent Acquisition, Recruitment)
- Automated outreach sequences using Linux-based tooling and tracked metrics in Confluence dashboards, which improved response rates by 45%. (Linux, Confluence)

Meesho — Apr 2020 - Aug 2021
HR Executive
- Executed high-volume Recruitment for customer support and seller operations during rapid growth, closing 300+ roles over 15 months while maintaining quality SLAs. (Recruitment, Talent Acquisition)
- Introduced competency-based screening and panel alignment processes that decreased early attrition by 18%. (Talent Acquisition, Recruitment)
- Partnered with business leads to forecast hiring needs and used Confluence to document role families and interview guides for faster ramp-up. (Confluence, Recruitment)

Bluefin Logistics — Jul 2017 - Mar 2020
Backend Engineer
- Developed and maintained Django-based microservices for shipment tracking and rate calculation, improving API response times by 40% through query optimization and caching. (Python 3, Django)
- Implemented background workers and Linux deployment scripts that increased batch processing throughput by 3x and reduced failed job rates. (Python 3, Linux)
- Collaborated with product and ops to deliver features that reduced manual reconciliation effort by 60% and supported scaling to 10x shipment volume. (Django, Python 3)

Projects
- Internal Hiring Dashboard: Built and maintained a Confluence-backed dashboard that consolidated pipeline metrics and interviewer feedback, reducing meeting prep time by 50%. (Confluence)
- Candidate Outreach Automation: Developed Linux-based scripts for personalized bulk outreach and tracking, increasing qualified response rate by 30%. (Linux)

Skills
Recruitment: Recruitment, Talent Acquisition
Languages & Frameworks: Python 3, Django
Tools & Platforms: Linux, Confluence
